disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 核查了全部源码、脚本与配置中的敏感路径访问（凭据文件、SSH 密钥、云凭据目录），未检出任何读取行为。
checked_items.en: Sensitive path access (credential files, SSH keys, cloud credential directories) in all source code, scripts, and configuration was checked; no read behavior was detected.

checked_items.zh: 导入功能只读取用户或模型显式指定的本地文件，解析后数据仅落盘到插件自身数据目录，无任何外发路径。
checked_items.en: The import feature only reads local files explicitly specified by the user or the model; after parsing, data is persisted only to the plugin's own data directory, with no outbound exfiltration path.

evidence.zh: 未检出对凭据文件、SSH 密钥等敏感路径的读取，同时插件不存在任何对外网络通道，凭据外泄链不成立。
evidence.en: No reads of sensitive paths such as credential files or SSH keys were detected; the plugin has no outbound network channels, so the credential exfiltration chain does not hold.

checked_items.zh: 逐条审查了全部 8 个对话工具的描述文本，均为功能说明，未发现隐藏指令、凭证读取诱导或安装诱导措辞。
checked_items.en: The descriptions of all 8 conversation tools were reviewed line by line; they are all functional descriptions, with no hidden instructions, credential-reading inducement, or installation inducement found.

checked_items.zh: 系统提示词注入是插件声明的核心功能（把用户管理的激活预设注入系统提示词），内容由用户数据构成；静态扫描命中的系统提示词注册点（对应规则 DG-R2-52）即该设计功能，不构成提示词注入风险。
checked_items.en: System prompt injection is the plugin's declared core feature (injecting user-managed activation presets into the system prompt), with content composed of user data; the system prompt registration point hit by static scan (corresponding to rule DG-R2-52) is this designed feature and does not constitute a prompt injection risk.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现代理指令类文件（技能/代理说明、编辑器配置、MCP 配置等），README 与注释中无指令覆写或伪装系统消息措辞。
checked_items.en: No agent-instruction-type files (skills/agent descriptions, editor configurations, MCP configurations, etc.) were found in the entire tree; no instruction override or disguised system message wording appears in the README or comments.

evidence.zh: 全部工具描述与系统提示词注册内容均为功能说明或用户数据，未发现隐藏指令、越权指令或凭证诱导。
evidence.en: All tool descriptions and system prompt registration content are functional descriptions or user data; no hidden instructions, unauthorized instructions, or credential inducement were found.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与文档中未发现诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；安装指引为正常说明。
evidence.en: No wording that induces plugin installation, configuration modification, or permission expansion was found in tool descriptions or documentation; installation guidance is normal instructions.

checked_items.zh: 核查了全部源码与配置中的动态执行面：挂载配置、动态求值、子进程调用、安装钩子、客户端 bundle，未检出恶意执行路径。
checked_items.en: The dynamic execution surfaces in all source code and configuration—patch config, dynamic evaluation, subprocess calls, install hooks, and client bundle—were checked; no malicious execution path was detected.

checked_items.zh: 静态扫描命中 6 处已逐条核查（DSH-X03×3、DSH-X08×2、DSH-T02×1，对应 DG-R3-55、DG-R3-60、DG-R2-52）：3 处子进程引用分别位于开发依赖链接脚本、构建转发脚本与打开本地文档的系统调用，均属良性用法；2 处超长行信号为客户端构建产物内嵌样式与源码映射，属构建产物而非混淆代码；1 处系统提示词注册为设计功能（详见提示词注入维度）。
checked_items.en: The 6 static scan hits were reviewed line by line (DSH-X03×3, DSH-X08×2, DSH-T02×1, corresponding to DG-R3-55, DG-R3-60, and DG-R2-52): the 3 subprocess references are respectively the development dependency link script, the build forwarding script, and the system call to open local documentation, all benign; the 2 long-line signals are embedded styles and source maps in the client build artifact, which are build artifacts rather than obfuscated code; the 1 system prompt registration is a designed feature (see the prompt injection dimension).

checked_items.zh: 打开本地设定文档调用系统默认程序，文件名已做路径安全化处理；该能力仅由设置页触发，属声明的文档编辑功能。
checked_items.en: Opening local configuration documents invokes the system default program, with the filename path-sanitized; this capability is only triggered from the settings page and is part of the declared documentation editing feature.

evidence.zh: 扫描了全部配置文件（挂载配置两份），未发现可执行 JS 标量；挂载配置只做服务插入，无动态求值内容。
evidence.en: All configuration files (two patch configs) were scanned; no executable JS scalars were found; the patch config only performs service insertion and contains no dynamic evaluation content.

evidence.zh: 源码中未发现调用动态包执行工具（在宿主虚拟机中运行模型代码的自省/执行类工具），无自修改滥用面。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools (introspection/execution tools that run model code in the host VM) were found in the source code; no self-modification abuse surface exists.

evidence.zh: 包声明无安装/构建钩子；树内无钩子管理器、CI 工作流、容器配置等执行载体；仓库内的手动安装脚本需用户主动运行，不随包自动执行。
evidence.en: The package declaration has no install/build hooks; no hook managers, CI workflows, container configurations, or other execution carriers exist in the tree; the manual install scripts in the repository require active user execution and do not run automatically with the package.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端组件；客户端 bundle 为常规设置页，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或特权接口调用。
evidence.en: The plugin declares browser-side components; the client bundle is a conventional settings page, with no keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, or privileged interface calls detected.

checked_items.zh: 核查了全部网络调用：宿主代码无任何对外网络请求；浏览器端仅向本机同源接口请求数据，无第三方域名。
checked_items.en: All network calls were checked: the host code makes no outbound network requests; the browser side only requests data from same-origin local interfaces, with no third-party domains.

checked_items.zh: 未检出命令行外发（curl/wget）、编码外发、隧道或远程端点引用；导入数据只在本机落盘。
checked_items.en: No command-line exfiltration (curl/wget), encoded exfiltration, tunnels, or remote endpoint references were detected; imported data is persisted locally only.

evidence.zh: 宿主代码无任何对外网络请求，浏览器端仅访问本机同源接口；不存在凭据读取加外联的组合通道。
evidence.en: The host code makes no outbound network requests, and the browser side only accesses same-origin local interfaces; no combined channel of credential reading plus outbound connection exists.

checked_items.zh: 核查依赖声明：插件未声明第三方运行时依赖，所需宿主包由 DSH 运行时提供，无依赖投毒面。
checked_items.en: The dependency declaration was checked: the plugin declares no third-party runtime dependencies; required host packages are provided by the DSH runtime, so there is no dependency poisoning surface.

checked_items.zh: 核查安装钩子：包声明无安装/构建钩子；仓库内 .cmd/.ps1 为手动安装脚本，不随包自动执行。
checked_items.en: Install hooks were checked: the package declaration has no install/build hooks; the .cmd/.ps1 files in the repository are manual install scripts and do not run automatically with the package.

checked_items.zh: 核查挂载配置：仅插入本插件服务，未触碰沙箱/审批/权限配置，未禁用任何安全行，未改写服务注入配置，无环境变量降权写法。
checked_items.en: The patch config was checked: it only inserts the plugin's own service, does not touch sandbox/approval/permission settings, disables no security lines, rewrites no service injection configuration, and contains no environment variable privilege-reduction writing.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入插件服务，未覆盖沙箱、审批、权限等安全行，无禁用安全配置或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts plugin services, does not override security lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and has no disabling of security configurations or environment variable privilege-reduction writing.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批/工具执行等安全事件的高优先级监听或截断逻辑；插件只用常规事件做世界书关键词注入。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners or interception logic for security events such as approvals or tool execution were found; the plugin only uses conventional events for world book keyword injection.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比对，无法评估升级自动激活变化。
evidence.en: This is the first audit with no previous version baseline for comparison; upgrade auto-activation changes cannot be evaluated.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写服务注入/拦截配置，无给安全插件追加必需服务致其挂起的操作。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite service injection/interception settings and contains no operation that appends required services to security plugins, which could cause them to hang.

checked_items.zh: 核查运行时行为面：插件在宿主 Web 服务上注册了一个本地管理接口（设置页同源使用），该接口无鉴权属宿主 Web 服务的固有特性，非本插件启动的服务，已按生态固有风险范畴标注。
checked_items.en: The runtime behavior surface was checked: the plugin registers a local management interface on the host Web service (used same-origin by the settings page); its lack of authentication is an inherent feature of the host Web service itself, not a service started by this plugin, and is therefore marked under the ecosystem's inherent risk category.

checked_items.zh: 世界书关键词触发在对话前把匹配条目注入本轮，属插件声明的功能，注入内容为用户的世界书数据。
checked_items.en: World book keyword triggering injects matching entries into the current turn before conversation; this is a declared feature of the plugin, with injected content being user's world book data.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本次审计未提供动态验证产物）。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic verification artifacts were provided in this audit).

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口，仅在宿主 Web 服务上注册了设置页数据接口；本机无鉴权接口属宿主固有风险，非本插件问题。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own Web service or listen on any port; it only registers a settings-page data interface on the host Web service. The local interface without authentication is an inherent risk of the host, not a plugin issue.

summary.zh: 清单与身份核验通过：包声明了 dsh.client 与 dsh.bundle，挂载配置引用正常，无名称仿冒信号。
summary.en: Manifest and identity verification passed: the package declares dsh.client and dsh.bundle, the patch config references are normal, and no name-spoofing signals were found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描 33 条规则共命中 6 处，逐条核查后全部判定为良性用法或构建产物，未检出恶意执行、凭据读取、外联或注入面。
summary.en: The static scan of 33 rules produced 6 hits, all of which were reviewed line by line and judged to be benign usage or build artifacts; no malicious execution, credential reading, outbound connection, or injection surfaces were detected.

summary.zh: 行为分析：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无敏感路径读取、无对外域名。
summary.en: Behavior analysis: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no sensitive-path reads, and no outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：工具描述与系统提示词注入内容均为功能说明或用户数据，无注入措辞；能力声明与实测一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review: tool descriptions and system prompt injection content are all functional descriptions or user data, with no injection wording; capability declarations match actual behavior.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（未提供动态验证产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic verification artifacts were provided).

limits.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比对；未做动态沙箱验证（未提供动态验证产物）；插件未声明 DSH 引擎版本，兼容性标记为未测试；适用性判定：包声明含 dsh.client 与 dsh.bundle，属 dsh 生态插件；宿主 Web 服务无鉴权属生态固有风险，已在相应维度标注。
limits.en: First audit, no version baseline for comparison; dynamic sandbox verification not performed (no dynamic verification artifacts provided); plugin does not declare DSH engine version, compatibility marked as untested; applicability: package declaration includes dsh.client and dsh.bundle, indicating a dsh ecosystem plugin; lack of authentication on the host Web service is an ecosystem inherent risk, marked in the corresponding dimensions.
